name: brink-dashboard
description: Internal Brink Design app: one site for each brink-merge project (Projects, then Takeoff | Schematic | BOM & Issues per project). A React SPA served by a Cloudflare Worker that reads Postgres through Hyperdrive, with a Durable Object relaying Supabase Realtime; the Schematic tab embeds the vendored EasySchematic editor (AGPL-3.0) and saves to the schematic edit layer.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run check:vendor && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
